| `drop_dm_object_name(Web)`

// Article-specific bespoke detection — Armored Likho digging a snake pit: inside the covert BusySnake Stealer campaign

| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where (FileName in~ ("psihologicheskiy_test.exe", "pnx.exe", "get-pip.py", "wh_selfdelete.vbs", "run.vbs", "telegram.exe"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName,
          FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc

DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified")
| where (FolderPath has_any ("/dev/null") or FileName in~ ("psihologicheskiy_test.exe", "pnx.exe", "get-pip.py", "wh_selfdelete.vbs", "run.vbs", "telegram.exe"))

| order by Timestamp desc

``` Article-specific bespoke detection — Armored Likho digging a snake pit: inside the covert BusySnake Stealer campaign ```
| tstats `summariesonly` count earliest(_time) AS firstTime latest(_time) AS lastTime
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes
    where (Processes.process_name IN ("psihologicheskiy_test.exe","pnx.exe","get-pip.py","wh_selfdelete.vbs","run.vbs","telegram.exe"))
    by Processes.dest, Processes.user, Processes.process_name,
       Processes.process, Processes.parent_process_name, Processes.process_path

| append [

    where Filesystem.action IN ("created","modified")

id: 6f3c1e8a-2b74-4d19-9f0a-8c5b2d41ae77
description: Detects the OpenAM/Tomcat JVM spawning a command shell or download LOLBIN, the post-exploitation footprint of the CVE-2026-45051 WebAuthn Java deserialization RCE.
references:
  - https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-6c99-87fr-6q7r
  - https://advisories.gitlab.com/maven/org.openidentityplatform.openam/openam-auth-webauthn/CVE-2026-45051/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/07/07
tags:
  - attack.t1190
  - attack.t1059
  - attack.t1059.001
  - attack.t1059.004
logsource:
  category: process_creation
detection:
  selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\java.exe'
      - '\javaw.exe'
      - '/java'
    ParentCommandLine|contains:
      - 'openam'
      - 'catalina'
      - 'tomcat'
      - 'jetty'
      - 'webauthn'
  selection_child:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\cmd.exe'
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
      - '\wscript.exe'
      - '\cscript.exe'
      - '\whoami.exe'
      - '\net.exe'
      - '\certutil.exe'
      - '\bitsadmin.exe'
      - '\curl.exe'
      - '/bin/sh'
      - '/bin/bash'
      - '/bin/dash'
  condition: selection_parent and selection_child
falsepositives:
  - Java-based admin tooling or scheduled jobs that legitimately shell out on the IdM host
level: high
3185.spl:
| tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.parent_process_name IN ("java.exe","javaw.exe","java") AND Processes.process_name IN ("cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","whoami.exe","net.exe","net1.exe","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe","curl.exe","wget.exe","sh","bash","dash","nc")) by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name Processes.process
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| where match(parent_process, "(?i)(openam|catalina|tomcat|jetty|webauthn)")
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)`
| `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
| sort - lastTime
3185.datadog: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 (@ParentImage:(*\\java.exe OR *\\javaw.exe OR *\\Java.exe)) (@ParentCommandLine:(*openam* OR *OpenAM* OR *catalina* OR *Catalina* OR *tomcat* OR *Tomcat* OR *jetty* OR *webauthn*)) (@Image:(*\\cmd.exe OR *\\powershell.exe OR *\\PowerShell.exe OR *\\pwsh.exe OR *\\wscript.exe OR *\\cscript.exe OR *\\whoami.exe OR *\\net.exe OR *\\certutil.exe OR *\\bitsadmin.exe OR *\\curl.exe))
3185.falcon:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ParentBaseFileName=/^(java|javaw)(\.exe)?$/i
| ImageFileName=/(\\(cmd|powershell|pwsh|wscript|cscript|whoami|net|certutil|bitsadmin|curl|wget)\.exe|\/(sh|bash|dash|nc))$/i
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ParentBaseFileName, ImageFileName, CommandLine], function=count())

3186.def:
// Article-specific bespoke detection — ESET takes part in Operation Endgame to disrupt Amadey and Stealc
// Hunts the actual binaries / paths / commandline fragments named
// in the article instead of a generic technique-class template.
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where (FileName in~ ("07.exe", "yinkaroj.exe", "ion.exe", "patch.exe"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName,
          FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc

// File-creation events for the named binaries / paths
DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified")
| where (FileName in~ ("07.exe", "yinkaroj.exe", "ion.exe", "patch.exe"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FolderPath,
          FileName, ActionType, InitiatingProcessFileName,
          InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc
3186.spl:
``` Article-specific bespoke detection — ESET takes part in Operation Endgame to disrupt Amadey and Stealc ```
| tstats `summariesonly` count earliest(_time) AS firstTime latest(_time) AS lastTime
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes
    where (Processes.process_name IN ("07.exe","yinkaroj.exe","ion.exe","patch.exe"))
    by Processes.dest, Processes.user, Processes.process_name,
       Processes.process, Processes.parent_process_name, Processes.process_path
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)`
| append [
| tstats `summariesonly` count
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem
    where Filesystem.action IN ("created","modified")
      AND (Filesystem.file_name IN ("07.exe","yinkaroj.exe","ion.exe","patch.exe"))
    by Filesystem.dest, Filesystem.user, Filesystem.process_name,
       Filesystem.file_path, Filesystem.file_name
| `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)`
]

status: experimental
description: Detects a macOS shell command line that fetches from a paste-site redirect (rentry.co/glot.io) and pipes a decoded payload to a shell - the ClawHavoc OpenClaw prerequisite-block lure.

3249.sigma:
title: Hades PyPI - Bun Runtime Spawned by Python Interpreter
id: d6041502-8e91-4adb-cf34-5a6b7c8d9e0f
description: Detects a Python interpreter or pip spawning the Bun JavaScript runtime, the Hades PyPI worm's on-import payload execution chain.
references:
  - https://www.stepsecurity.io/blog/miasma-and-hades-are-spreading-now-detect-them-on-developer-machines-with-suspicious-files
  - https://thehackernews.com/2026/06/hades-pypi-attack-19-packages-poisoned.html
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/20
tags:
  - attack.t1059.007
  - attack.t1059.006
  - attack.t1105
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\bun.exe'
      - '\bun'
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\python.exe'
      - '\python3.exe'
      - '\pythonw.exe'
      - '\pip.exe'
      - '\pip3.exe'
  condition: selection
level: high
3249.spl: | tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name="bun.exe" OR Processes.process_name="bun") AND (Processes.parent_process_name IN ("python.exe","python3.exe","pythonw.exe","pip.exe","pip3.exe")) by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name Processes.process | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)
